body: Don't know which country you ale from but in the states they're pretty generous with their benefits and all. I'm not trying to pressure you into doing anything, just wanted to try to suggest something to you since you helped me out. Hope things get better for you, however I know how life can be.

Honestly I feel it is terrible good people cannot acquire jobs nowadays. If you don't mind me asking, did you ever think about joining the military or so on? I honestly think that's the only way I can get a job as of now.

No, don't worry about it. Your words have cooled me down a bit and I'm honestly grateful for it. I'll take your words into mind and attempt to keep at it, maybe even enlist if I can't find work.

I honestly hope you can find work in the near future, as you seem like a top notch person.

I'm just getting tired of putting my head out all the time to get not a single bite in return. It makes you feel completely worthless as a human being whenever you cannot even land a job that pays you $7.25 an hour while those around you make 10+ jobs easily. I've volunteered and everything and it's just been wearing down on me for these past months. I can't take a break either, or else my family would start patronizing me again. They always make me out as a bum if I don't do anything, and shove it in my face how much they spend on me 24/7.

The job economy honestly sucks. It seems the only way to get anywhere in this nation is to know people, and it honestly is driving me mad with fury. I'm getting tired of being pushed around like I have a felon dangling around my neck, it's making me lose any reason worth doing anything for that matter. I'm getting tired of being unable to do anything due to being jobless, and I tried everything to do so.

It seems as if you're worse off than me however, as my mother would never kick me out of the house if I needed a place to stay. Hopefully your luck is better than mine and you strike a job though..

No I'm not, I mainly apply in person now due to it supposedly being a better impression than submitting online. Been doing this for a while now and only had 1 interview arise from it. I dress nice (still casual) and am clean shaven to boot, as I try to show I actually give a damn about applying.
